messages:
lee: Deploy-bot blocked prod promotion for redwood/worker:4.0.0 - registry manifest digest != attested digest (eu-ecr). holding release.

deploy-bot: :warning: publish-guard: provenance mismatch detected
attested_manifest=sha256:aa1000... registry_manifest=sha256:aa2000...
build_id=202603221030 cosign=present

maya: canary was fine for functional tests. we only run the provenance gate at staging->prod. looks like a push-time rewrite.

noah: I'll check eu-ecr push logs and s3 staging. sometimes the push-proxy trims trailing zeros on a layer and that changes the manifest ordering.

ops-bot: attach excerpt from uploader logs:
```
2026-03-22T10:30:02Z INFO uploader: multipart upload complete
2026-03-22T10:30:05Z WARN registry-proxy: normalized layer digest (trimmed trailing padding)
2026-03-22T10:30:06Z INFO attestor: created attestation (manifest=sha256:aa1000...)
2026-03-22T10:30:08Z INFO registry: stored manifest sha256:aa2000...
2026-03-22T10:30:08Z ERROR provenance: attested vs registry digest mismatch
```

maya: options: 1) wait for replica convergence (unlikely to fix attestation), 2) republish under new tag (4.0.0-rp1) with canonicalized manifest, 3) rebuild from scratch. I prefer 2 for speed.

lee: +1 republish as 4.0.0-rp1 and re-attest. make sure QA runs full provenance lint on the republished tag.

noah: republish plan: pull blobs from eu-ecr, canonicalize manifest by sorting entries and normalizing digests, push as 4.0.0-rp1 with pinned manifest digest, re-sign attestation using cosign, update canary mapping.

ops-bot: manual_republish queued by noah for build_id=202603221030.

noah: pulled blobs, found layer blob with extra null padding that registry normalized. recreated canonical manifest and pushed 4.0.0-rp1 -> digest sha256:aa3000... attaching attestation.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: republish complete. registry_manifest=sha256:aa3000... attestation attached.

maya: QA starting provenance lint + canary smoke on 4.0.0-rp1. ping when green.

lee: decision: do NOT promote original 4.0.0 tag. promote 4.0.0-rp1 to canary, run a gradual rollout if QA passes, and keep original tag pinned for 30m for audit. add note in release notes about the republish due to layer normalization.

maya: QA green. requesting 5% gradual rollout now.

deploy-bot: manual rollout requested by maya: route 5% traffic to redwood/worker:4.0.0-rp1.

noah: monitoring looks fine at 5%. will ramp per rollout playbook. creating follow-up ticket to add an early provenance check to the CI pipeline to prevent this escaping staging.

lee: thanks all. logging this thread in the release audit and updating release-notes.md. :thumbsup:
